name: Black: the Accelerated Dragon and the King's Indian
about: The owner's choice of Black opening (TRACKER Q18, 2026-11-17): the King's Indian and the Sicilian; asked which Sicilian, the Accelerated Dragon (2...Nc6 and an early ...g6, the King's Indian's bishop on g7); asked what against White's other first moves, the King's Indian setup (...Nf6, ...g6, ...Bg7, ...O-O, ...d6). Where the masters' usual move would leave that setup the setup's move is used (the owner's rule, D97): 3...g6 after 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 (masters 4,142 games to 4,305 for 3...e5), and 1...c5 against 1.Nc3 (into the Closed Sicilian). The chapter list was drawn up by Claude from those choices, not taken from a course; every move in it is checked against the masters' games (at least 25). The chapters name the owner's moves and the White moves the owner wants a chapter for; moves only. Everything past them comes from the Lichess masters database (every move played in at least the book rule's number of games), checked by the engine.
